candidates.change_summary: Replace `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender] += 1;` so the credited amount no longer equals the deposited ether.
Delete the balance update statement so deposits are never credited.
Replace the accumulation with an assignment `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;`, discarding any prior balance.
Insert `balances[msg.sender] = 0;` after the balance update so every deposit resets the balance to zero.
Remove the balance decrement so withdrawing no longer reduces the recorded balance.
Remove the ETH transfer so no funds are sent while the balance is still decremented.
Invert the guard condition so withdrawals succeed only when the amount exceeds the balance.
Send the withdrawn ETH to the contract creator instead of the caller.
Delete the payable(to).transfer(...) statement so migrateTo no longer sends the contract balance.
Delete the require(creator == msg.sender) guard so anyone can trigger the balance transfer.
Invert the access check to require(creator != msg.sender), allowing everyone except the creator to migrate.
Change the transfer amount to 0 so no funds are moved on migration.
